_about: Hand-written paraphrases of the generated step descriptions (steps.json, field 'description').
The generator writes '<label> <role>'. A tester does not: the 'terse' variant is what someone
types into a Robot test in a hurry (bare label, 'the X button', a verb), the 'wordy' variant
describes the purpose or the look and often drops the exact label or the role word, so the
lexical tier cannot match it and the model tier has to.
Written on 2026-10-28 by the project's assistant, not by the step generator and not sampled
from the DOM; reviewed by the author. Run with
